categories.main_business_segments: M.J. International Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of flooring products, including SPC (Stone Plastic Composite), LVT (Luxury Vinyl Tile), WPC (Wood Plastic Composite), and other related flooring materials. The company also engages in OEM and ODM services for flooring products and invests in subsidiaries related to flooring and real estate development.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced SPC and LVT production technologies, focusing on environmentally friendly materials such as PVC-free and PET-based composites. It emphasizes sustainable manufacturing processes, including ISO 9001, ISO 14001, SA8000 certifications, and green product certifications like FloorScore and Green Guard. The company also incorporates IoT and smart manufacturing techniques to enhance product quality and operational efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: M.J. International serves a diverse customer base including flooring distributors, construction companies, interior designers, and end consumers in residential, commercial, and industrial sectors. Its products are used in markets requiring durable, eco-friendly, and high-quality flooring solutions, targeting both domestic and international customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan, with significant business activities and subsidiaries in China, the United States, Thailand, and Hong Kong. It serves global markets through its international subsidiaries and partners, focusing on Asia-Pacific, North America, and expanding into other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: M.J. International functions mainly as a midstream manufacturer and downstream distributor in the flooring supply chain. It controls production, product development, and sales, while also engaging in OEM/ODM manufacturing for other brands, positioning itself as a key player in product innovation and market delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in sustainable and environmentally friendly flooring materials, including PVC-free and recycled content products. It invests in smart manufacturing, quality certifications, and green building standards compliance. Innovation focuses on enhancing product durability, aesthetics, and eco-certifications to meet evolving market demands and regulatory requirements.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of flooring materials and related products, including direct sales to distributors and end-users. Additional income streams include OEM/ODM manufacturing contracts, licensing of proprietary technologies, and investment income from subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: M.J. International competes with major flooring manufacturers such as Shaw Industries, Mannington, Tarkett, Mohawk, and other regional players. It positions itself as a leading Taiwanese flooring manufacturer with strong capabilities in SPC and LVT technologies, emphasizing sustainability and quality certifications to differentiate in the competitive global flooring market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported revenues of approximately NT$3.86 billion in 2024, representing a 45.47% increase from the previous year. Net income showed significant growth, with a 522.69% increase in operating profit and a 310.20% rise in net profit attributable to shareholders. The financial trajectory indicates robust growth driven by expanding market demand and successful product innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: M.J. International emphasizes high-quality, environmentally friendly flooring solutions with certifications such as ISO 9001, ISO 14001, SA8000, FloorScore, and Green Guard. Its products offer durability, aesthetic appeal, and compliance with green building standards, catering to customers seeking sustainable and innovative flooring options. The company’s integration of smart manufacturing and commitment to R&D further differentiate its offerings in the global market.
